subject: general
question: Modhera Dance Festival is an annual cultural phenomenon in the _________ district of the state of Gujarat.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mehsana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Modhera **

 
 
• **Modhera** is a village in the South-west of **Mehsana** District, **Gujrat**.
 
• The **three-day** Modhera Dance festival is held every year during the third week of January after the conclusion of the **Uttarayan festival**.
 
• Modhera, the **temple** of the **Sun** narrates the history of its **patrons**, the **Solankis **in an architectural marvel.
 
• This festival of dance, Uttarardh Mahotsav, derives its name from the planetary and astronomical configuration of the Sun.
 
• This festival takes place every year after **Uttarayan**, at the Modhera temple dedicated to the Sun God.
 
• Uttarayan is the day when the sun starts its voyage towards Uttar or North indicating the end of winter and the beginning of longer days with a pleasant breeze.
 
• During Uttarayan, the Sun migrates from one planet to the other, it travels from **Dhanu or Sagittarius** to **Makara i.e Capricorn**.
 
• Halfway through this voyage, when the ‘**ardh**’ or half of ‘**uttar**’ or Northward journey is over, the period is known as **Uttararadh**.

• **Gandhinagar** is the capital of Gujarat.
 
• **Bhupendrabhai Rajnikantbhai Patel** is an Indian politician and the current Chief Minister of Gujarat since September 2021.
 
• **Acharya Devvrat** is an Indian politician and former educationalist who is serving as the 20th Governor of Gujarat.
 
• **Garba**, is a type of Indian dance commonly performed at festivals and on other special occasions in the state of Gujarat, India.
